outcome: Diagnosis of cardiac and non-cardiac disease
Emergency transfer to a cardiac centre
finding: In apparently healthy newborns, early assessment of oxygen saturation, combined with clinical assessment and subsequent intervention can identify important conditions and should be considered as standard care.
mod_finding: Infants born by elective caesarean section were 28 times more likely to have oxygen saturations <95%.
followup_time: Within the first 6 hours of life
